---
title: "Overall survival censoring scenarios — preparation"
subtitle: "Best and worst cases without covariates or imputation"
format: html
---

- Best case: censored over 14 days before follow-up end, assumed alive to the end.
- Worst case: the same participants die on their censoring day.
- Recorded deaths and censoring within 14 days of the end: unchanged.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(knitr)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)

scenario_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "06-censoring", "results", "scenarios"
)
dir.create(scenario_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Follow-up data

```{r}
#| label: read-cohort
#| include: false

cohort <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"),
  col_select = c(
    "id",
    "tx",
    "survival_time_days_unrestricted",
    "status_death_unrestricted",
    "potential_follow_up_days"
  )
)

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(cohort),
  !anyDuplicated(cohort$id),
  all(cohort$tx %in% 0:1),
  all(cohort$status_death_unrestricted %in% 0:1),
  all(is.finite(cohort$survival_time_days_unrestricted)),
  all(is.finite(cohort$potential_follow_up_days)),
  all(cohort$survival_time_days_unrestricted >= 0),
  all(cohort$potential_follow_up_days >= cohort$survival_time_days_unrestricted)
)
```

## Scenarios

```{r}
#| label: build-scenarios
#| include: false

cohort <- cohort |>
  mutate(
    censored_near_lock = status_death_unrestricted == 0L &
      potential_follow_up_days - survival_time_days_unrestricted <= 14
  )

best_case <- cohort |>
  transmute(
    id,
    tx,
    censored_near_lock,
    observed_death = status_death_unrestricted,
    scenario = "best-case",
    survival_time_days = if_else(
      observed_death == 1L | censored_near_lock,
      survival_time_days_unrestricted,
      potential_follow_up_days
    ),
    event_death = observed_death
  )

worst_case <- cohort |>
  transmute(
    id,
    tx,
    censored_near_lock,
    observed_death = status_death_unrestricted,
    scenario = "worst-case",
    survival_time_days = survival_time_days_unrestricted,
    event_death = as.integer(observed_death == 1L | !censored_near_lock)
  )

# A day-zero death needs positive time in the continuous PH likelihood. Half
# a day keeps it in the first week; the original time is kept for KM.
scenarios <- bind_rows(best_case, worst_case) |>
  mutate(
    fitting_time_days = if_else(
      survival_time_days == 0 & event_death == 1L,
      0.5,
      survival_time_days
    )
  )

recorded_death <- cohort$status_death_unrestricted == 1L
stopifnot(
  nrow(scenarios) == 2 * nrow(cohort),
  identical(best_case$id, worst_case$id),
  identical(best_case$tx, worst_case$tx),
  all(worst_case$survival_time_days <= best_case$survival_time_days),
  # Recorded deaths keep their event and their recorded time in both cases.
  all(best_case$event_death[recorded_death] == 1L),
  all(worst_case$event_death[recorded_death] == 1L),
  all(
    best_case$survival_time_days[recorded_death] ==
      cohort$survival_time_days_unrestricted[recorded_death]
  ),
  all(
    worst_case$survival_time_days[recorded_death] ==
      cohort$survival_time_days_unrestricted[recorded_death]
  ),
  # Every death enters the likelihood with positive time (day-zero deaths at
  # 0.5 days); only day-zero censoring keeps a fitting time of zero.
  all(scenarios$fitting_time_days[scenarios$event_death == 1L] > 0),
  all(
    scenarios$fitting_time_days > 0 |
      (scenarios$survival_time_days == 0 & scenarios$event_death == 0L)
  )
)

write_parquet(
  scenarios,
  file.path(scenario_dir, "scenarios.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

## Scenario counts

```{r}
#| label: scenario-counts
#| include: false

scenario_counts <- scenarios |>
  summarise(
    participants = n(),
    observed_deaths = sum(observed_death),
    originally_censored = sum(observed_death == 0),
    early_censored = sum(observed_death == 0 & !censored_near_lock),
    censored_near_lock = sum(censored_near_lock),
    assumed_deaths = sum(event_death - observed_death),
    scenario_deaths = sum(event_death),
    scenario_censored = sum(event_death == 0),
    day_zero_deaths = sum(survival_time_days == 0 & event_death == 1),
    zero_follow_up_censored = sum(fitting_time_days == 0),
    .by = c(scenario, tx)
  )

write_parquet(
  scenario_counts,
  file.path(scenario_dir, "scenario-counts.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-supporting-os-censoring-scenarios-counts
#| tbl-cap: "Observed and assumed deaths in each censoring scenario (0: usual care; 1: ctDNA)"
#| echo: false

kable(scenario_counts)
```
